#### Describe the bug

When the DNI required settings is turned on, existing used addresses with no DNI cannot be updated.

#### Expected behavior

When I update the missing DNI field of an address used in an order, I expect the used address to be updated silently (with the deleted flag set to 1) and I expect a new address to be created.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Ensure that the DNI to not required for the default country in International > Locations > Countries (no dni in the address format and Do you need a tax identification number? set to No)

title: Fix compiled legacy container
issue_title: Services in front container are not available once the container is cached
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

If you try to access one of the following service:
- `configuration`
- `context`
- `db`
- `shop`
- `employee`
from the front container when the cache is empty, the first time you try to access it, it will work, but not the second time when the cache is created.

#### Expected behavior

Services should be always available

#### Steps to Reproduce

1. Clear the cache `rm -rf var/cache/*`
2. Open `controllers/front/IndexController.php` and add the following lines in the `initContent()` function:
```php
$container = ContainerBuilder::getContainer('front', true);
$entityManager = $container->get('shop');
```
3. Open your browser and try to access the front office of your shop
4. No error
5. Refresh
6. See error

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.9, 1.7.7.x, 1.7.8.x, develop
* PHP version: N/A

issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

Reported [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/24253#issuecomment-849614195)
This issue occurs when we have multi-invoice (more than 2 invoices created).
When we try to add the same product to a specific invoice, a modal is displayed.
It shouldn't, we need to have only alert `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Create an order
2. Go to BO > Orders > View last order created with `Product1`
3. Generate an invoice
4. Add the same product `Product1` with creating a new invoice
5. Add the same product to any invoice with changing the product price 
6. See error: a modal `Edit the price` is displayed => it shouldn't, we should have `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

**Another case**

1. Create an order
2. Go to BO > Orders > View last order created with `Product1`
3. Generate an invoice
4. Add the same product `Product1` with creating a new invoice
5. Edit the product price and confirm the update
5. Add the same product to any invoice without changing the product price 
6. See error: a modal `Edit the price` is displayed => it shouldn't, we should have `Error! This product is already in the invoice #IN00000x, please edit the quantity instead.`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/119973446-c7f97e00-bfb3-11eb-9684-1637ad766e4c.png)

With PS176 => we can add the same product without any alert

* PHP version: 7.2

#### Describe the bug

Mimetype for svg is wrong in the filemanager configuration. It doesn't allow to upload svg files

```
//**********************
//Allowed mime types
//**********************
$mime_img = array('image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/bmp', 'image/tiff', 'image/svg');
$mime_file = array('application/pdf');
$mime_video = array('video/mpeg', 'video/mp4', 'video/x-msvideo', 'audio/x-ms-wma', 'video/x-flv', 'video/webm');

$mime = array_merge($mime_img, $mime_file, $mime_video);
```

SVG mimtype is "image/svg+xml" https://www.w3.org/TR/SVG11/mimereg.html

#### Expected behavior

#### Describe the bug

When the multistore option is activated and at least two shops have been created, a new panel is displayed at the bottom of module configuration pages, containing a checkbox labeled "Activate module for this shop context". title: Handle info flash messages in Twig layout
issue_title: Flash messages of type 'info' are not displayed in PrestaShop migrated pages
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

If you use function
```
$this->container->get('session')->getFlashBag()->add($type, $message);
```
in PrestaShop Symfony pages, the types 'failure', 'error', 'warning' and 'success'  are displayed but not the type "info".

#### Expected behavior

When using
```
$this->container->get('session')->getFlashBag()->add('info', $message);
```
in a Symfony controller I should be displayed the message

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to Customers Back Office page
2. Modify `src/PrestaShopBundle/Controller/Admin/Sell/Customer/CustomerController.php` function `indexAction()`. Insert the following lines in the function
```
        $this->addFlash('error', 'A');
        $this->addFlash('failure', 'B');
        $this->addFlash('success', 'C');
        $this->addFlash('warning', 'D');
        $this->addFlash('info', 'E');
```

So your CustomerController::indexAction function now looks like
```
    public function indexAction(Request $request, CustomerFilters $filters)
    {
        $this->addFlash('error', 'A');
        $this->addFlash('failure', 'B');
        $this->addFlash('success', 'C');
        $this->addFlash('warning', 'D');
        $this->addFlash('info', 'E');
        
        ...
```

title: When saving an image as a square png, add always a transparent border
issue_title: Using `png_all` option in BO, all images should have transparent background in FO
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

This is somewhere between a bug and an improvement.

When choosing `Use PNG for all images` (`png_all`) as Image format (in menu *Design - Image Settings*), the background is transparent when the original image is in png format and white otherwise.

#### Steps to reproduce
1. Use these two images. [test_images.zip] One is in png format, and one is in jpg format (https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/6279138/test_images.zip)
2. In menu *Improve - Design - Image Settings*, under *Image generation options*
    for *Image format* choose *Use PNG for all images*
    for *Generate images based on one side of the source image* choose *Automatic (longest size)*
3. Upload both images into a product.
4. Go to the image folder and inspect the generated images.

#### Observed behavior
The resulting resized images are different. Even though they are both saved as png, one is transparent and the other is not (the added border is white, when the original file was in jpg format, and it is transparent when the original was in png format.
a) The original was jpg. The result is a png with a white border (`cart_default` size).
![62673-cart_default](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/115393433-faa89d80-a1e1-11eb-8fbd-df532c7537fe.jpg)
b) The original was png. The result is a png with a transparent border (`cart_default` size).
![83771-cart_default](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/115393505-114ef480-a1e2-11eb-874d-ac3aa101ac25.jpg)
Change github.com to dark mode to see the difference immediately. Or see below https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/23920#issuecomment-822564239 for a screenshot.

#### Expected behavior
I expect both images to be visually the same, with a transparent border. The output format is png for both, because we 
have choosen *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), therefore both should have a transparent border.

This would allow for more flexibility for the design of the templates. Also it makes more sense to always make use of the advantages the png format offers when we choose *Use PNG for all images* (`png_all`), and not make the use of transparency dependent on the source format.

#### Backwards compatibility

This should be backwards compatible, since images whose original format is png are already transparent.
It removes the constraint that a template must give a white background to the image in order to hide the difference between a jpg and a png image.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.6.1.1 and 1.7.7.3
* PHP version: any

title: Fix thumbnail regeneration for files other than jpg

#### Bug description
If some thumbnails of product images are missing, Prestashop automatically generates them on the fly for JPG images, but not for PNG images. This can happen if regeneration goes wrong, during custom external imports from suppliers etc.

#### How to reproduce this bug

1. Go to your Prestashop image settings and set image format to "Use PNG if original file is PNG".
2. A) Make a product, name it "JPG Product", upload few images in JPG format.

3. A) Find id_image of one JPG image, go to /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ and delete all thumbnails. Do not delete XXXXX.jpg, filetype and index.php.
3. B) Find id_image of one PNG image, go to /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ and delete all thumbnails. Do not delete XXXXX.jpg, filetype and index.php.
4. A) Open JPG Product, see all images correctly. Check /img/p/X/X/X/X/X/ folder and see all thumbnails go back.
4. B) Open PNG Product, images are gone and not regenerated.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.2
* PHP version: 7.2

In that Pack product I have added a combination product with quantity 100. The combination product itself has less than 100 quantity availability (for example, 99). Global setting for packs is to "Decrease both". My Global Availability preference is "Deny orders" when out of stock. _Result_: It is possible to add to cart and purchase the pack. This results in my combination product having a negative quantity after the purchase. Check screenshot. _Expected_: It should not be possible to purchase the pack with this scenario. **Screenshot:** **Additionnal information** PrestaShop version: 1.7.5.0 PHP version: 7.2.17 --- > Originally posted by @theodiablo in #23706 #### Describe the bug I have a pack of products, which is the same products but with his different variations. When one of those product variation is out of stock, the pack is still enabled. #### Expected behavior The pack should be disabled and display the "Email me when product is back on stock" form I have #### Steps to Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior: Using the basic Prestashop installation 1. Create a product pack containing several variations of the product "Hummingbird printed t-shirt" s-white, s-black, m-white, m-black for instance 2. In Quantities tab, set "Decrement products in the pack only" option 3. Go to your newly created product, it should be displayed correctly and you can add it to the cart (remove the product if added) 4. Set the stock product "Hummingbird printed t-shirt" "S Black" variation to 0 5. Go to the product page, see that it is displayed as if it had items, however it should be disabled 6. Add the product to your cart, an error comes out. The pack quantity should be 0, but it is 3000. #### Screenshots Variations quantities ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8282971/111818228-3bf61680-88df-11eb-9e30-ef745a0c23d1.png) Pack content ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8282971/111818312-503a1380-88df-11eb-8c12-eb82517412a2.png) Pack quantities config (auto calculated wrong) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8282971/111818385-67790100-88df-11eb-9db8-00b40d90569f.png) Button enabled, even when one variation has 0 stock ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8282971/111818566-9becbd00-88df-11eb-8ac0-686ab9a35db5.png) Error message after clicking on the "add to cart button" ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8282971/111818169-2d0f6400-88df-11eb-987f-6475cd95e786.png) #### Additional information * PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.2 * PHP version: 7.2

### Prerequisites - [x] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots The display of the profiling output contains errors: - In Stopwatch SQL the times are labelled as milliseconds, but they are microseconds in reality - In Stopwatch SQL, the display of the stacktrace does not work, because `
` is HTML-escaped - In Doubles, the placeholders' HTML is also escaped See screenshots: ![2021-11-23_165341](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445824-f3ead5e9-55e3-40bc-90f9-9a8398a5e602.jpg) ![2021-11-23_165407](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445686-cddf68ad-1660-4cbb-8940-2bf2642434f9.jpg) ### Expected behavior The display should be corrected as follows: - In Stopwatch SQL display the times as milliseconds and add digits after the comma to keep precision. - In Stopwatch SQL, do not escape `
` - In Doubles, do not escape the placeholders Screenshots : ![2021-11-23_165831](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445860-63f46611-9d2a-4050-b624-808db85e3575.jpg) ![2021-11-23_165757](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143445853-19d4fab0-6d99-442c-8997-5ffac7717065.jpg) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Enable Profiling mode - On your server, open the /config/defines.inc.php file. - Find this line (around line 43): define('_PS_DEBUG_PROFILING_', false); - In this line, change "false" to "true". 2. title: Fix Combination::getIdByReference returns wrong id
issue_title: If ID_product is not defined, we can't find combination by reference
issue_body:
### Describe the bug

If there is one row in SQL table product_attribute that has id_product = 25 and reference = demo_10

Then if I run `$id = Combination::getIdByReference(25, 'demo_1');` this will return the above record because a LIKE is used in the query instead of a equality.

`$id = Combination::getIdByReference(25, 'demo_1');` should return a result if there is a row that has id_product = 25 and reference = demo_1 not demo_10

<hr>

#### Describe the bug

Actually, we can find a combination by reference only related to a specific product.
We could be retrieve combination in global context without take in consideration a specific product.

> Reported [here](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/26467) by @saiif

Combination::getIdByReference() returns wrong id 

#### Expected behavior

$id = Combination::getIdByReference(500);
return the same id 
$id = Combination::getIdByReference(5000);
cause like is used for the query 

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

$id = Combination::getIdByReference(500);
return the same id 
$id = Combination::getIdByReference(5000);

-------------------------------------------------------------------------

#### Expected behavior

Search reference without provide a product information
You can follow this [comment](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/20454#issuecomment-668689318)
#### Steps to Reproduce

Not relevant

* PrestaShop version: develop
* PHP version: 7.x

title: Fix disabled attribute on checkout on classic
issue_title: After upgrade, theme must be updated to be able to pay into the final step on PrestaShop 1.7.8
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

Since PrestaShop 1.7.8, a change inside the core.js affect all themes and disallow the possibility of payments inside the checkout.

This issue was introduced with this pull request: https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/18904/

As now, the disabled thing is moved on class and not on attribute.
As like every theme have followed the Classic theme about that, if someone update it's PrestaShop without using Classic (and even without update CLassic, as it's possible), it will disallow the payment.

#### Expected behavior

We can add the disabled class, but the remain of disabled attribute into the JavaScript is needed.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install PrestaShop 1.7.7.8

title: Fix SQL query in OrderQueryBuilder
issue_title: BO - Orders - impossible to extend order grid query from module
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

When you try to modify Orders list query from a module using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook, always gets an error by using the "New client" filter.

#### Expected behavior

A module could extend orders list query using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook with no errors.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Develop a module to add a new column on backoffice Orders grid using actionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier hook.
2. Add a new data column to Orders grid (similar to example for Customers grid from official doc: https://devdocs.prestashop.com/1.7/modules/sample-modules/grid-and-identifiable-object-form-hooks-usage/#extending-grid-query-builder)
2. Click on backoffice Orders menu
3. Use "New client" filter with any value (Yes or No) and click on Search button
4. An error 500 is shown due to and incorrect table alias

**Screenshots**

- Module hooks code:
![1](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567527-49093a00-c9e4-11eb-9d18-16fa920a64ad.JPG)
![2](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567547-4dcdee00-c9e4-11eb-9236-9edd66e36a34.JPG)

hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier code:
```
public function hookActionOrderGridDefinitionModifier(array $params)
{
    $definition = $params['definition'];

    $definition->getColumns()->addAfter(
        'date_add',
        (new BooleanColumn('from_app'))
            ->setName($this->l('App order'))
            ->setOptions([
                'field' => 'from_app',
                'true_name' => $this->trans('Yes', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'false_name' => $this->trans('No', [], 'Admin.Global'),
                'clickable' => true,
            ])
    );

    $definition->getFilters()->add(
        (new Filter('from_app', YesAndNoChoiceType::class))
        ->setTypeOptions([
            'required' => false,
        ])    
        ->setAssociatedColumn('from_app')
    );
}

public function hookActionOrderGridQueryBuilderModifier(array $params)
{
    $searchQueryBuilder = $params['search_query_builder'];

    $searchCriteria = $params['search_criteria'];

    $searchQueryBuilder->addSelect(
        'app.`id_order` IS NOT NULL AS `from_app`'
    );

    $searchQueryBuilder->leftJoin(
        'o',
        '`app_order_table`',
        'app',
        'app.`id_order` = o.`id_order`'
    );

    if ('from_app' === $searchCriteria->getOrderBy()) {
        $searchQueryBuilder->orderBy('app.`id_order`', $searchCriteria->getOrderWay());
    }

    foreach ($searchCriteria->getFilters() as $filterName => $filterValue) {
        if ('from_app' === $filterName) {
            $searchQueryBuilder->andWhere('app.`id_order` IS ' . ($filterValue ? 'NOT' : '') . ' NULL');
        }
    }
}
```
- Error details:
![3](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/18466848/121567574-58888300-c9e4-11eb-848c-f746a80b4062.JPG)

#### Additional information

A further investigation show that error came from leftJoin alias used on $searchQueryBuilder modification. The problem is that standard "o" alias completly change on query builder when a "New client" filter is used. This is caused by an incorrect subquery that do not use standard "o" alias (in fact do not use any alias at all) on https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/src/Core/Grid/Query/OrderQueryBuilder.php#L275. This makes impossible to extend orders query using a join stament unless you remove "New client" filter and column from grid.

* PrestaShop version: develop
* PHP version: N/A

title: Do not use virtual cart for saving quantity in stock
issue_title: OrderDetail->product_quantity_in_stock is wrong
issue_body:
**Describe the bug**
This commit screwed up the logic of computing items-in-stock quantity.
https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/64e6f9e1d4068bd1ebab78c089e08d16c928fcd9#diff-706c99b0aadf150c801cec8a83a90cc1

Wrong line (1.7.6.2):
`$product_quantity = (int)Product::getQuantity($this->product_id, $this->product_attribute_id, null, $cart);`

Correctly functioning (from 1.6.1.23):
`$product_quantity = (int)Product::getQuantity($this->product_id, $this->product_attribute_id);`

**To Reproduce**
1. Make a product, set quantity to 1.
2. Check ps_stock_available, search the id_product, should be like this: quantity: 1, physical_quantity: 1, reserved_quantity: 0.
3. Order 1 piece of the product.
4. Go to order detail in BO, you will see a warning that the product you ordered was not/is not in stock. You also won't see the blue circle under the products quantity in the product list.
5. Check ps_order_detail, search the id_product and id_order, you will find **product_quantity: 1, product_quantity_in_stock: 0**.  But it should be **product_quantity: 1, product_quantity_in_stock: 1**.
6. Now, try it in older Prestashop or try it with the mentioned line change in classes/order/OrderDetail.php. It will work fine.

I do not want to make a PR, I don't know why this change was introduced, but on my side, I reverted it and I don't see any abnormalities.

**Additional information**
PrestaShop version: 1.7.6.2

title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_title: Footer from next invoice shown on invoice when exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range)
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

When exporting multiple invoices (i.e. invoices by date range), the footer of the following invoice is shown on the current invoice erroneously. This meant that in a multi-store environment, the wrong store details could be output on the invoice footer, which can create a compliance issue, especially if different tax information should be displayed. The issue resolves around the use of TCPDF, where the footer needs to be output after AddPage, otherwise the last page of a page group will end up having the footer of the next page group.

#### Expected behaviour

The footer should be output using the correct store details.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behaviour:

1. In a multi-store environment -- set up multiple stores with different data, such that the footers on invoices would differ depending on which store items were ordered from
2. Place and invoice a mixture of orders - switch between stores when placing orders
3. Export orders using the invoices by date range functionality
4. Where invoices switch between stores, the footer belonging to the store of the next invoice will be shown on the current invoice

I will submit a pull request with a fix.

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.8 (although also in previous versions)
* PHP version: 7.3.29

title: Fix warning on the Customer Threads page
issue_title: Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable
issue_body:
#### Description

When saving the imap settings on the backend customer service page the following error is shown.

`Warning on line 1021 in file /prestashop/controllers/admin/AdminCustomerThreadsController.php [2] count(): Parameter must be an array or an object that implements Countable`

LINE 1014 = `$errors = imap_errors()` 
this returns a boolean when there are no errors.

LINE 1021 = `if (count($errors) && is_array($errors) {` _[current code]_
This is because the IF-statement which checks the $errors array is in the wrong order.
If nothing is returned from imap_errors() then $errors becomes a boolean which isn't countable

Changing LINE 1021 fixes the issue 
`if (is_array($errors) && count($errors))  {` _[fix code]_
 -> switching the 2 options of the IF-statement

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to 'Customer Service' in the backend
2. Setup IMAP settings & Save
3. Revisit the 'Customer Service' page
4. See error



#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.2
* PHP version: 7.3

title: Change jQuery-ui position before theme.js to avoid overriding bootstrap ones
issue_title: jQuery UI overrides bootstrap tooltip component
issue_body: #### Describe the bug When modules adds jQuery UI library (for example ps_searchbar, ps_facetedsearch), it is included in template due to higher priority after theme.js where bootstrap library is included. Bootstrap and jQuery UI uses $.fn.tooltip method for their tooltip components. When jQuery UI is included it overrides bootstrap tooltip method. #### Expected behavior JQuery UI should be included before theme.js file. To prevent it from overriding bootstrap tooltip component. #### Steps to Reproduce Steps to reproduce the behavior: 1. Go to product page. 2. Open `themes/classic/templates/catalog/product.tpl` and place there inside `{block name='page_header_container'}` block. ``` tooltip hover me ``` 3. Open `themes/classic/assets/js/custom.js` and paste this code: ``` $(() => { $('[data-toggle="tooltip"]').tooltip(); }) ``` 4. Go back to product page and hover on that span. Tooltip should appear with white background and box-shadow (it is jQuery UI tooltip). 5. Go BO and disable ps_searchbar module. 6. Go back to product page and refresh. 7. Hover on span and red tooltip should appear. (it is bootstrap tooltip). #### Additional information * PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.5 * PHP version: N/A

title: Fix actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate call location
issue_title: hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate not working correctly
issue_body:
<!--
****************************
DO NOT disclose security issues here, contact security@prestashop.com instead!
****************************
-->

#### Describe the bug

There is a problem with the hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate.
In the following code, the hook is never called because I have an TransistEmailSendingException but the trackingNumber is updated. The hook should be before email exception.

```
if (!empty($trackingNumber) && $oldTrackingNumber != $trackingNumber) {
            if (!$orderCarrier->sendInTransitEmail($order)) {
                throw new TransistEmailSendingException('An error occurred while sending an email to the customer.');
            }
            $customer = new Customer((int) $order->id_customer);
            $carrier = new Carrier((int) $order->id_carrier, (int) $order->getAssociatedLanguage()->getId());
            Hook::exec('actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate', [
                'order' => $order,
                'customer' => $customer,
                'carrier' => $carrier,
            ], null, false, true, false, $order->id_shop);
        }
```

#### Expected behavior

If there is an error on updating the tracking number should not be updated. But in our case it is updated.
The hook need to be fire before the emailing error.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Install the module ps_qualityassurance
2. Create an hook actionAdminOrdersTrackingNumberUpdate
3. Disable emailing on your server or local environnement
4. The hook is not called

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.7.5

title: Fix blocking add to cart button
issue_title: The product-list on the checkout does not work with custom themes
issue_body:
#### Describe the bug

This fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 breaks the "Add to cart" buttons in the product-list in all custom themes.

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9


Fix https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/9634 adds to core.js this code to disable the "Add to cart" button:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

The problem is that all custom themes use this code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"
to add the "Add to cart" button in the product-list, which means that after an update to 1.7.8.x all shops with custom themes will have this problem and it is difficult to fix it directly in the theme.

You can go here:
https://addons.prestashop.com/en/3-templates-prestashop
open any theme and check the source code of the "Add to cart" button in the product-list to see that all themes use in the product-list that code:
data-button-action="add-to-cart"


#### Expected behavior

The "Add to cart" button should be disabled only on the product page in the form:
form#add-to-cart-or-refresh

In means that this code in the core.js:
$('[data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

should be replaced with something as this:
$('form#add-to-cart-or-refresh [data-button-action="add-to-cart"]').prop('disabled', true);

or this code should be removed from core.js and added to /themes/classic/assets/js/theme.js


#### Steps to Reproduce

1.Install a custom theme with the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

2.Click the "Add to cart" button in the product-list.

3.After the popup is closed, all other buttons will be disabled.


**Screenshots**
Before clicking the "Add to cart" button:
https://prnt.sc/18a24cm

after closing the popup, all buttons are disabled:
https://prnt.sc/18a1zux

Short movie:
https://www.loom.com/share/1ed22057f0964fee84eaaf9bcc73a3c9

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: 1.7.8.0

#### Describe the bug

#### Steps to Reproduce

<!--

****************************

#### Describe the bug

When creating a catalog specific price rule **_using conditions_**, the rule is not working as expected if you choosed the second shop on a multi shop installation of prestashop.

#### Expected behavior

The conditions should target the selected shop.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Configure a multi shop with 2 shops
2. Create a category available only in the second shop
3. Create a product available only in the second shop (shop id 2)
4. Create a catalog specific price rule (`/admin/index.php?controller=AdminSpecificPriceRule`) and select the second shop in the shop dropdown
5. Add a condition to target the category of the product.
6. Save he rule
7. See that the discount is not applied to the product. (table `ps_specific_price` is empty)

#### Additional information

The problem happens because `getAffectedProducts` method uses `Context::getContext()->shop->id` instead of the selected shop id.

title: Fix cart rule shop association
issue_title: Shop associations for cart_rules are saved without taking into account the employee permissions
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

In a multishop environment, when selecting all available shop in Shop selection, nothing is saved to `ps_cart_rule_shop`, or if there are entries, they are deleted. This is correct if the employee has access to all shop. It is wrong if not.

**Case 1:**
An employee has access to only one shop. If he creates a cart rule, it is valid in all shops. There is no way to avoid this behavior.
This can have disastrous consequences: If the employee does not understand what he does, he can offer free orders in any random shop. If shops are independent, this is a nightmare.

**Case 2:**
A cart rule is limited to one shop (created by an employee with permissions for more than one shop).
An other employee, that has only permissions in that shop, views the cart rule and saves it without changes.
Now the cart rule is corrupted, and applies to all shops.

**Case 3:**
A cart rule is limited to one shop. An employee with access to two shops adds the second shop and saves it. Now the cart rule is valid in all shops, and the checkbox `shop restriction` has been removed (what represents an error).

### Expected behavior

I expect, that the shop associations of a cart rule reflect the permissions of the creator of the rule. There must be no possible permission escalation.

**Case 1:**
If an employee is restricted to a set of shops, all cart rules he creates must be restricted to shops inside that set.

**Case 2:**
If a cart rule is limited to a set of shops, these shop associations must not change, unless there is a explicit action by the user.

**Case 3:**
If `Shop restriction` is checked, it must not be removed. A cart rule associated to two shops must remain associated to the two shops, unless there is a explicit action by the user.

### Steps to reproduce

Setup:
- Multishop environment with at least three shops
- Edit or create a employee profile with permissions for cart rules, and use this profile for creating two employees as follows:
- An employee A that has permissions only for shop A
- An employee B that has permissions for shop A and B

**Case 1:**
1. Log in as employee A
2. Create a cart rule
3. Note that there is no option to select `Shop restriction` in the conditions tab 
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/162452737-0c30e332-7647-4a65-b157-3c818eb5ef4c.png)
4. Log in as super admin
5. Find the new cart rule, click on `Edit`
6. In the conditions tab > note that the cart rule has no `Shop restriction` and is valid in all shops.

https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/162452982-80e2717a-bb57-4b4b-9878-550c0c705eae.mp4


**Case 2:**
1. Log in as super admin
2. Create a cart rule restricted to shop A
3. Log in as user A
4. View the cart rule, do not make any modification, and click on `Save`
5. Log in as super admin
6. Note that the shop restriction has been removed from the cart rule

**Case 3:**
1. Log in as user B
2. Create a cart rule restricted to shop A
3. Edit the cart rule
4. Add shop B to the shop restrictions, click `Save and stay`
5. Note that `Shop restrictions` has been unchecked
6. You can note the same thing as super admin

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.6.1.1, 1.7.7.1, 1.7.8.5

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.3

_No response_

- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

In the delivery PDF template the date displayed in the header is the invoice date and not the delivery date.
Exemple : 
My customer create an order the third of march (2022-03-03) the paiement is OK so there is an order invoice created at the same date.
The order is prepared by the service the fourth of march (2022-03-04), so the status order is «Preparation in progress» and the order invoic is updated to set the delivery_date at 2022-03-04.
At this point, the order was created the third, the invoice date is the third and the delivery date is the fourth.

When I download the delivery slip pdf, the header date is not the delivery date but the invoice date.

### Expected behavior

The date in the delivery slip PDF has to be the date of the delivery slip and not of the invoice slip …
The template should use the delivery_date on the OrderInvoic object instead of the creation date.

### Steps to reproduce

1 - Create an order with teh status «Accepted paiment»
2 - Wait until the next day
3 - Change the order status to generate a delivery slip

title: Multistore - Product on category page display out of stock flag instead of availlable on order
issue_title: [Multistore] - Product on category page display out of stock flag instead of availlable on order
issue_body:
### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots >Edited by Khouloud Steps to reproduce the issue: 1. Enable Multistore & Create new Group shop with Share quantity = enabled 2. Create a shop assiciated to this Group shop 3. Create a product with quantity = 0 & allowed for order 4. Go to FO of the shop2 > Category list 5. See error > The product is displayed with out-of-stock flag ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/153606126-320f965a-e2e0-4302-b44a-9dd91f947656.png) Hello, i'm back with my bug and i found the cause: On catagory page i have product display as out of stock even if the product is availlable for order. But if I access to the product page, status is ok and product can be added on cart. More, when I add the product to cart, the status on category page change for the good status until the product are removed from the cart. Not all product are affected. I searched in code and the problem come from the out_of_sotck parameter to define if you can order product out of stock. For some product the value of out_of_stock is empty on category page instead of 0,1 or 2. In this case it should be 1. **Product.php line 5579:** ` $row['allow_oosp'] = Product::isAvailableWhenOutOfStock($row['out_of_stock']);` Problem is only on category page. Home page, product page, search page are ok. To avoid loosing customer i disable message on category page ![123515636-7b7b8e00-d698-11eb-853f-76c3ce5b1a0c](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675137-c44cd4ee-ffaf-4ccd-960f-0c635e5b574b.png) ![128632685-d1507f7f-9bf3-4c52-8459-34b62a81d6ac](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675149-ebaed18e-23ac-48ef-9cbf-82baae25733f.png) ![128632731-46a0e0c9-5313-4dec-85c8-4040db14b05a](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675154-59fd6ed0-5b2b-4ae7-8363-faadd7b23f43.png) ![128632843-5d73b17b-3530-48b5-939e-0583711376be](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675158-4444a40f-40ce-4183-8e0b-edaba510dff0.png) I try to come back on the classic theme to identify if the problem occurs too. At first glance, no message is displaying and it seems to be normal. But classic theme doesn't display out of stock or allows order by default. If stock equal 0, no message is displayed. I try with not allow and allow order: **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach}
{/block} ``` But if i add the check on allow on order (product.allow_oosp) and display message, we can see that property is not initialize with correct value on catalog part and availability message is wrong : **themes/classic/templates/catalog/_partials/product-flags.tpl** ``` {block name='product_flags'}
    {if $product.quantity > 0} {foreach from=$product.flags item=flag}
  • {$flag.label}
    • {/foreach} {else} {if !$product.allow_oosp}
  • {$product.availability_message}
    • {/if} {/if}
{/block} ``` **Root cause :** After a long investigation, i found that : On class ProductAssemblerCore (ProductAssembler.php in classes foler), there is a SQL request that seach information for product. This request seach stock information by product shop and don't take account that stock is configurated to share stock 👍 ``` LEFT JOIN {$prefix}stock_available sa ON sa.id_product = p.id_product AND sa.id_shop = $idShop ``` ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25029253/152675471-d815e5f1-9383-4833-ae81-d25d5d5c89ac.png) So on category page for shared stock management between shop, information about stock are wrong ### Expected behavior When a product is availlable for order even if its qty equal 0, display on demand on category page. ### Steps to reproduce **You need to have multishop with shared product stock** 1. Define product witch capability to be order even if stock are equal to 0 2. Define stock to 0 3. Show product on category page 4. Flag is out of stock instead of On-demand ### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened 1.7.8.3 ### PHP version(s) where the bug happened 7.4 ### If your bug is related to a module, specify its name and its version _No response_

<!--

-->

#### Describe the bug

Error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values` when modify and save customer information in BO. 

Error arrive because of invalid value of field `date_add" = 0000-00-00 00:00:00`.  If change this value to real date directly in DB, error disappear.  When we import customers, **Registration date** is used for `date_add`, so autodate is `false`, and `date_upd` is `0000-00-00 00:00:00`. Why not to set `date_upd` => `date('Y-m-d H:i:s')`, in `self::$default_values` in AdminImportController.php ?

#### Expected behavior

No error when save customer information.

#### Steps to Reproduce

Steps to reproduce the behavior:

1. Go to **Advanced Parameters** - **Import** , and import **Customers**. You can use sample **csv** file. 
2. Go to **Customers** page, open Edit customer page.
3. Try to save customer information. Not necessary to modify something.
4. See error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Customer\Exception\CustomerException code 0]: Customer contains invalid field values`.

title: Don't check if an invalid address exists over and over again
issue_title: Too many queries to test if address_id exists
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

When there is a product in the cart and I'm not logged in, Prestashop is repeating this query 30 times

    SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE `id_address`  FROM ps_address a  WHERE a.`id_address` = 0 LIMIT 1

Additionally the logic is suspect, because the query does not check if the address is marked as deleted or if it is active. This would be necessary, since the addresses are soft-deleted in the address table.

The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page. Checking the individual queries in Stopwatch SQL shows that all queries are exactly the same.

![2021-11-25_161510](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143466190-ec24be8e-1271-4f87-b7ba-304fa80108d8.jpg)


### Expected behavior

Never check if address with `id_address = 0` exists. It must never exist.
Check only once if an address exists, remember the answer.
Even better: good execution logic would test only once for the existence of the address saved in the cart.

To-do:

- [x] #28321

- [ ]  Investigate the core of the issue to understand: why we are doing so much queries (related to how we store the adress in the cache of the cart) ?

### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable Profiling mode
3. Add a product to your cart
4. Scroll down to query doubles, you'll notice that there is 30x the same query on the table `address`.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.7.8.0

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.3

title: Fix forbidden access page in Front Office
issue_title: Error in Front controller when checkAccess() returns false
issue_body: ### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots While documenting the flow of Front controllers, I found a rather peculiar call path: ![Weird call path](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/1009343/147365412-71aace00-8c27-4991-9801-d562c37d995c.png) As of 1.7.8, Front controllers [systematically call `displayMaintenancePage()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L493). This method will display the maintenance page and exit [only if the maintenance mode is activated](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L763). Otherwise, it will let the flow of execution continue. The execution flow (standard for front and back) will then call the `checkAccess()` method, theoretically [to determine if the current user can access the page or not](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/Controller.php#L155). In admin controllers, this will check the XSRF token. In Front controllers, this [returns returns true by default](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L247) (except in AuthController, where it [will redirect if the user is already logged in](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L247)). The standard behavior of controllers is to call `initCursedPage()` when `checkAccess()` returns false. In Admin controllers, this will [display the "invalid token" page](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/AdminController.php#L2288) that we all know and love. In Front controllers, oddly, this [redirects the flow to `displayMaintenancePage()`](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/1.7.8.0/classes/controller/FrontController.php#L611) again, although at this point in we already know that the site is not in maintenance mode. This means that execution flow will always continue, leading to this error: For all we know, this bug might be at least 10 years old, and it only happens when `checkAccess()` returns false **and** the shop is not in maintenance mode. ### Expected behavior I expected to get an "access forbidden" error message. ### Steps to reproduce This can be reproduced easily by modifying `FrontController::checkAccess()` to make it return false instead of true (like a custom controller would do). After having modified this, access any Front office URL and you will get the error. ### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened I think this affects all versions since at least 1.5 ### PHP version(s) where the bug happened 7.4 ### If your bug is related to a module, specify its name and its version _No response_

title: Avoid using _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_
issue_title: Problem with orders with amounts without decimals
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

When Prestashop is configured so that it does not use decimals, when validating the order with the 'validateOrder' method, the order is marked with payment error (PS_OS_ERROR)

on line 323 the error is thrown
```php
if ($order_status->logable && number_format($cart_total_paid, Context::getContext()->getComputingPrecision()) != number_format($amount_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_)) {
    $id_order_state = Configuration::get('PS_OS_ERROR');
}
```

In the if, the amount is validated with the constant _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_ and the configuration of the currency is not checked. In this case the variable **_$cart_total_paid_** always has a difference with the amount paid (**_number_format($amount_paid, _PS_PRICE_COMPUTE_PRECISION_)_**).

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/36648048/140820904-b65822bc-b83f-408d-860b-94b7ed222edf.png)


### Expected behavior

The order is marked with the correct status

### Steps to reproduce

1. Install clean Prestashop versión >= 1.7.8.0.
2. Create currency without decimal and set as default.
3. Install the `Payment by check` and enable it or use a payment method that set the status of payment in `payment accepted (ps_order_state id 2)` or `Processing in progress (ps_order_state id 3)`.
3. Create an publish product with price lower than $1000.
4. Create and publish product with price higher than $1000.
5. Buy a product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with a price less than $ 1000. It should work fine.
6. Purchase product with the `Payment by check` payment method or the one configured with price higher than $1000. This will fail and set order to Payment Error state.

1.7.8.0

title: Instead of testing each hook if it is active, query once and cache.
issue_title: Too many queries to test if hook is active
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

Prestashop is repeating this query several dozens of times
```
SELECT active
FROM `ps_hook` h
WHERE (h.name = "**") LIMIT 1
```
The screenshot are from Profiling mode on a product page:
![2021-11-25_111717](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143424749-7ccd8bfc-e566-47f7-8e4f-b5d45f790f53.jpg)
![2021-11-25_111754](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143424759-862b8d4a-7f45-42ed-be19-88cd7386ff71.jpg)
![2021-11-25_111816](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143424779-41b054ad-69b6-4f95-bb84-c48ae91b1a17.jpg)



### Expected behavior

Query once the table ps_hook. Then a simple `in_array($hook_name, $active_hooks)` will do it. This can save dozens of queries depending on the page, even more than hundred (/!\) on a category page.

Screenshot on the same product page with proposed PR:
The table ps_hook is queried 7 times instead of 74
![2021-11-25_113115](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/143425335-7934ca5b-4422-4dec-80ac-7db421fa4b00.jpg)



### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable Profiling mode
2. Open a FO page, search on the page for PREFIX_hook, you'll see an impressive number
3. Scroll down to table stress: hook is the champion.

title: Don't catch exception that implements ModuleErrorInterface
issue_title: Module user-displayable exceptions not working anymore
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

The pull request https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/14239 adds the possibility for modules to display error on controllers thanks to the exception ModuleErrorException.

But because of this commit https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/commit/a5619cc54a121e553b3aeb46ef2076c2a6b58f20 all modules exceptions are catch during the call of callHookOn method.

With this try/catch, the exception is no longer raised to the FrameworkBundleAdminController class and the error is not displayed to user.

### Expected behavior

Throw an exception that implements `\PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Module\Exception\ModuleErrorInterface` inside a module should display an error message for users.

For example :
```
public function hookActionAfterUpdateCustomerFormHandler(array $params)
 {
     throw new CustomException('This is a nice display message');
 }
```

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6272184/216982428-ba07e818-4870-4b28-8025-4733460ae17b.png)


### Steps to reproduce

- Install [attached module](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/10663154/module_for_pr_hook_error.zip)
- Go to Back-Office customer page
- Update a customer
- No message is displayed to the user


### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.0.1

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

8.1.13

title: Fallback to first found combination when fetching combination by all shops constraint
issue_title: Shop association between combination and shop not found when updating product
issue_body: ### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add attachments Product page v2. Error happens when we try to load combination by shop constraint (CombinationRepository->getByShopConstraint) using All shops constraint. For All shops code tries to load combination for default shop, but in case it doesn't exist it will throw exeception. For example doing product with combinations update, code will try update all default suppliers and for that it will search for combinations in all shops (because suppliers are not related specifically to any shop) and it will throw CombinationShopAssociationNotFoundException. ### Expected behavior Its valid case that combination might not exist in some shop, but we still need to get combination info, so instead of error we should fallback to any another combination that is associated to shop. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Have multishop enabled and at least 2 shops. 2. Go to product v2 combination tab 3. Generate any different combinations in those 2 shops (its important that combinations between shops differs, else doesn't matter) 4. try to update any product field, lets say "label when in stock" with some random valid value 5. Save & see error `An unexpected error occurred. [PrestaShop\PrestaShop\Core\Domain\Product\Combination\Exception\CombinationShopAssociationNotFoundException code 0]: Could not find association between Combination {someId} and Shop {some shop id}` ### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened 8.1.x, develop ### PHP version(s) where the bug happened _No response_ ### If your bug is related to a module, specify its name and its version _No response_

issue_title: Unable to add a first address with error "Invalid postcode" in some circumstances
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

As a customer, I'm unable to create my first address with a country that has not the 'NNNNN' zip code format.
![Immagine 2023-01-20 115746](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/213679356-6c368d48-b47a-4077-a00e-f31ac4f68664.png)

This bug happens in this circumstances
- Multishop installation
- Main shop has default country `France`, second shop has default country `Switzerland`
- `France` is not associated to second shop, `Switzerland` is not associated to main shop


### Expected behavior

It should be possible to add an address with any country in the drop down list.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create a clean installation of Prestashop using https://gist.github.com/lmeyer1/c40a19d880758bee11a1e8a2c5e819c3
2. Log into BO, `All shops` context
3. Go to `International - Locations - Countries`, enable `France`. Make sure `France` and `Switzerland` are both enabled.
4. Click on `France`. In shop associations, uncheck `Shop A`
5. Click on `Switzerland`. In shop associations, uncheck `Prestashop default`
6. Go to `International - Localization`
7. Change to `Prestashop default` context. Set `France` as *Default country*.
8. Change to `Shop A` context. Set `Switzerland` as *Default country*.
9. As a customer open Shop A.
10. Create a new account
11. In `Your Account` click on `Add first Address`
12. Enter an *Address*, enter a *Zip code* with four numbers (as Swiss zip codes are), enter a *City* and select `Switzerland` as *Country*.
13. Click save and learn that in Switzerland post codes with 4 numbers are invalid: it says `Invalid postcode - should look like "NNNNN"`

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.0.0, not able to reproduce on 1.7.8.7

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

8.4

issue_body: ### Prerequisites - [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) - [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug. ### Describe the bug and add screenshots Impossible to create new customer via webservices URL/api/customers?schema=blank gives an error : ``` 5 [PHP Notice #8] Trying to access array offset on value of type null (/home/.../public_html/classes/webservice/WebserviceOutputBuilder.php, line 669) 5 [PHP Notice #8] Trying to access array offset on value of type null (/home/.../public_html/classes/webservice/WebserviceOutputBuilder.php, line 716) ``` ### Expected behavior It should done something like : ``` ``` ### Steps to reproduce Create a new customer with webservice > Originally posted by @ceer (see the [comment](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/pull/29258#issuecomment-1223126475)) Here’s is the way to reproduce the bug 1. title: Fix customer isLogged property in FO
issue_title: is_logged property in FO is true even for guests
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

Something is broken on 8.0 and develop - guest customers haves `is_logged = true` for some reason.

This results in wrong behavior of modules that use it. For example, ps_customersignin returns a logged in customer with no name and a list of non-functional links. The same for customer account links in footer.

![Snímek obrazovky 2023-01-22 162928](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/6097524/213924164-d7e0f58e-0e65-4b28-9320-d1acdaf7eaa4.jpg)

**Does not happen on previous versions.**

### Expected behavior

`$customer` object in front office should NOT return `is_logged` `true` in case of guests.

I traced the behavior to `$customer->isLogged` function, there is a difference, when 8+ returns true for `Context::getContext()->cookie->isSessionAlive()` call. This change is probably correct.

What is not correct is the call. `$cust['is_logged'] = $this->context->customer->isLogged(true);`. Changing it to `$cust['is_logged'] = $this->context->customer->isLogged();` fixes the issue.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Use hummingbird or classic theme. To better see the issue, add `{dump($customer)}` to `templates\_partials\header.tpl`.
2. Now add something to cart, go to checkout, fill out the first step WITHOUT a password, just as a guest - name and email only. Go to step 2.
3. On hummingbird, you will see it right away, on classic, go somewhere where you can see footer. See that there are links indended for loggd in customer, with "sign out" button. And when you click them, it redirects you to login page. Also if you check the dumped data on the top, see that the customer has `logged_in` true or 1.

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.0, develop

title: Fix SQL error introduced by da10f001
issue_title: PS 8.0.1. class/Customer.php function getSimpleAddressSql() generates incorrect SQL
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add attachments

In 8.0.1 was added ORDER BY expression to class/Customer.php function getSimpleAddressSql().
But it was not considered next optional adding expression for filtering by id_address.
Condition "AND a.`id_address` = xxx" ignored because of incorrect SQL statement "ORDER BY a.`alias` AND a.`id_address` = xxx":

```
SELECT DISTINCT
                      a.`id_address` AS `id`,
                      a.`alias`,
                      a.`firstname`,
                      a.`lastname`,
                      a.`company`,
                      a.`address1`,
                      a.`address2`,
                      a.`postcode`,
                      a.`city`,
                      a.`id_state`,
                      s.name AS state,
                      s.`iso_code` AS state_iso,
                      a.`id_country`,
                      cl.`name` AS country,
                      co.`iso_code` AS country_iso,
                      a.`other`,
                      a.`phone`,
                      a.`phone_mobile`,
                      a.`vat_number`,
                      a.`dni`
                    FROM `ps_address` a
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country` co ON (a.`id_country` = co.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country_lang` cl ON (co.`id_country` = cl.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_state` s ON (s.`id_state` = a.`id_state`)
                     INNER JOIN ps_country_shop country_shop
        ON (country_shop.id_country = co.id_country AND country_shop.id_shop = 1)
                    WHERE
                        `id_lang` = 1
                        AND `id_customer` = 2
                        AND a.`deleted` = 0
                        AND a.`active` = 1
                    ORDER BY a.`alias` AND a.`id_address` = 16663
```
And as result will be selected all the customer addresses, but not the one filtered by id_address. 

### Expected behavior

function getSimpleAddressSql() should return one selected address filtered by id_address. 
Correct generated SQL code should be the following:
```
SELECT DISTINCT
                      a.`id_address` AS `id`,
                      a.`alias`,
                      a.`firstname`,
                      a.`lastname`,
                      a.`company`,
                      a.`address1`,
                      a.`address2`,
                      a.`postcode`,
                      a.`city`,
                      a.`id_state`,
                      s.name AS state,
                      s.`iso_code` AS state_iso,
                      a.`id_country`,
                      cl.`name` AS country,
                      co.`iso_code` AS country_iso,
                      a.`other`,
                      a.`phone`,
                      a.`phone_mobile`,
                      a.`vat_number`,
                      a.`dni`
                    FROM `ps_address` a
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country` co ON (a.`id_country` = co.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_country_lang` cl ON (co.`id_country` = cl.`id_country`)
                    LEFT JOIN `ps_state` s ON (s.`id_state` = a.`id_state`)
                     INNER JOIN ps_country_shop country_shop
        ON (country_shop.id_country = co.id_country AND country_shop.id_shop = 1)
                    WHERE
                        `id_lang` = 1
                        AND `id_customer` = 2
                        AND a.`deleted` = 0
                        AND a.`active` = 1
                        AND a.`id_address` = 16663
                    ORDER BY a.`alias`
```
### Steps to reproduce

php call $customer->getSimpleAddress($id_address);

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.0.1

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.4.20

#### Describe the bug

On the develop branch, when you save a product variant with a negative quantity (ex: -10) then reload the page, the quantity becomes positive (ex: 10).

#### Expected behavior

The variant quantity should be negative

#### Steps to Reproduce

1. Create new product
2. Add 2 new variations:
A variation with quantity -10
B variation with quantity 10
3. Save product and reload page
4. See error => A variation with quantity 10 => NOK
5. Back to the list
6. See error => the product quantity is 20, it should be 0

**Screenshots**

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1uetwWtXEH314PMDMYYI7kjtR3C3KWv9K/view

#### Additional information

* PrestaShop version: develop
* PHP version: 7.2

---
Originally posted by @tswfi in this [comment](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/14913#issuecomment-891091122)

title: Use relative urls for Quick Access menu

issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

I the BO, the Quick Access links contain the domain. As a consequence, in a multishop environment, on gets potentially logged out when using Quick Access, because the domain of the BO changes unexpectedly. This is quite annoying.

### Expected behavior

No link in the BO must log me out. All the links must be relative to the domain and not include the domain.

title: Do not reset customization in FO when changing combination (178x)

issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

If our store has a product with customization and combination options and a customer, in the product page, first adds a customization and then changes the combination, the ID of the combination changes to "0" ("product_customization_id" input) and some weird stuff can be done, like having in the cart a product that has a mandatory combination without it, or having a product with two customizations. In the steps to reproduce, I show some examples of this behavior and if you read that section you will understand the problem.

### Expected behavior

When we add the same product twice but with two different customizations, two products should appear in the cart with one customization each, and when we delete one product, only one should remain with it's customization.

### Steps to reproduce

Create a customizable product and add some combinations (we used sample "Customizable mug" product, and added some size combinations). Product should look like this:
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181243297-c8a3987c-4ea8-4a39-8570-fda75bb1c74e.png)
First, add a product customization (write some text and click "save customization") and then change the combination (order is the key).
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181248736-b44e1cef-8bf0-4c13-8156-5b2b338a0aa5.png)

If you inspect the input id="product_customization_id" you will see that value after the combination change has changed to "0", but customization is still shown to the user in the form above. If you refresh the page, product_customization_id value will be back to normal. But it is not only that, we can manage to do some weird stuff:

Let's start again: Access the product page, add some customization, change the combination and add the product to cart. Everything should look fine. Then repeat the process again. Add to the cart the same product with other customization and size (remember, first we have to select the customization and then change the combination).

Now the cart looks weird. We have two mugs but with two customizations each:

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181244635-2dc5f660-f27f-4fe7-abd9-c8d3b64efecb.png)

If we try to delete one mug from the cart, we see that customizations dissapear, or even we can't remove one mug (at least in the interface, if we refresh the page, the cart is empty). This way we can manage to buy a customizable mug that has a mandatory customization without it.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/50045374/181246225-69fd13d9-cd45-4e35-9471-148b818a2c5b.png)

Probably, more weird things can be done this way.


### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.7.8.7 and 8.0.0

7.4.29 and 8.1.7

title: Remove inifinite loop on actionObjectUpdateAfter hook
issue_title: Hook actionObjectUpdateAfter - Infinite loop that leads to memory limit in FO
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [x] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

Hi,
i don't understand why the core is doing this but i'm facing an infinite loop when customer is loggedin but its totally logical if I read the code. First it was working but since I hooked a module on actionObjectUpdateAfter i get this syndrom.

I searched in code and this is what i found

When we are logged in as customer on front, 
It calls 
1. Hook::exec 
which check user logged in groups in Hook class with the method 
2. getHookModuleExecList who calls
3. getAllHookRegistrations.
This function calls 
4. $customer->isLogged() 
and this function calls 
5. Context::getContext()->cookie->isSessionAlive()
this function calls (on cookie class)
6. $this->getSession($this->session_id)
and the getSession method calls 
7. $session->save() 
who calls in object model the 
8. update() method who calls the 
9. hook actionObjectUpdateAfter who tried to Hook::exec 
then restart this infinite loop (back to 1.) .

I succed to stop this look by adding in objectModel line 864 

```
if(get_class($this) != 'EmployeeSession' && get_class($this) != 'CustomerSession'){
	Hook::exec('actionObjectUpdateAfter', ['object' => $this]);
	Hook::exec('actionObject' . $this->getFullyQualifiedName() . 'UpdateAfter', ['object' => $this]);
}
```
But with this it breaks the hook actionObjectUpdateAfter on EmployeeSession class and CustomerSession which extends ObjectModel too...

Edit : I figured out that natively (I mean when fresh install prestashop) this hook is not in database and is added only once a module is attached to this hook ( actionObjectUpdateAfter ) si until the hook doesn't appear in ps_hook table there is not this issue but when the row exists in ps_hook we got an infinite loop....

### Expected behavior

We can't have an infinite loop...

### Steps to reproduce

1. I attached a module on actionObjectUpdateAfter but the module is uninstalled since (i don't know if it is linked to this i checked on DB there is no more entries of attached module on this hook) ...
2. I logged in in front and i get a max execution time with a random location of killing process.. (it's never the same end position)

issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

In Prestashop, a CMS category can be hidden, and contain displayed CMS pages.
This makes sense. Maybe we want to show a link to a CMS page, but we don't want to display the list of all pages in the same CMS category. To achieve this, we can set `Display: Yes` for the page and `Display: No` for the CMS category.

But, in this case, the breadcrumb is not correct: In fact the Breadcrumb contains a link to the CMS category, and clicking on it gives a not found error.

### Expected behavior

If a CMS category is set to `Display: No` and the page to `Display: Yes`, the breadcrumb of that page should not show the hidden category. Instead of `Home > Hidden category > Page title`, it should simply read `Home > Page title`. 

### Steps to reproduce

1. Go to the BO, menu `Appearance - Pages`
2. Create a new category with name `Secret name` and select `Display: No`.
3. In that category, create a new page with title `New Page` and select `Display: Yes`.
4. In the FO, navigate to the new page
 => notice that the breadcrumb displays `Home > Secret name > New Page`
5. Click on `Secret name`

title: Fixed exception when downloading credit slip on an order with a deleted product
issue_title: BO - credit-slips - An exception is displayed when downloading a credit slip with deleted product
issue_body:
## Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

## Describe the bug and add screenshots

In the BO > Orders > Credit slips page on PrestaShop 8.0.0, an exception is displayed when downloading a credit slip with a deleted product

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187721189-7277cc31-3955-4f4a-813b-2ebc81261050.png)

_Important: I didn't reproduce the issue with php7.2, thanks @hibatallahAouadni_

## Expected behavior

The expected behavior is the behavior from PrestaShop 1.7.8.7

I checked with PrestaShop 1787 with php7.2 : behavior is correct.

### If the credit slip has only one product that has already been deleted from the order details, this is the display
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187721921-1caec1b0-5c7b-442c-b6e2-aec94d3e38ad.png)

### If the credit has more than one product

####Before deleting the product
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187723215-e18d0af1-ec78-4e57-afed-5b271b802ac7.png)

#### Then if you delete a product from the order details it now looks like this
![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187723303-b03f1770-3504-4b54-8302-210c01e39eaa.png)


## Steps to reproduce

1. Enable debug mode
2. Create an order from the BO or FO
3. Go to backoffice page BO > Orders > View to look at the order you just created
4. Change the order status to 'payment: accepted', this validates the order
5. Click on 'Partial refund' button and use the interface to 'return the product': this simulates an order where a user is not satisfied with product and returns the sold product, and prestashop creates a refund
6. From the order page, **remove the product** from the order details page 

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187726147-170e1b65-c9bf-4102-b384-d3b523448bf1.png)

7. Go to backoffice page BO > Orders > Credit slips page
8. Click on "Download Credit slip" for the order
9. See error: exception message

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/16067358/187725640-ed07682f-e760-4c0c-a7cf-ecb4a51ab723.png)

10. Click on "Generate PDF file by date"
11. See exception 

## PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

8.0.0beta, 1787

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.4, 8.0

title: Duplicated join in query.
issue_title: Duplicated join in Hook.php leads to inefficient query
issue_body:
### Prerequisites

- [X] I understand and accept the project's [code of conduct](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/blob/develop/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md)
- [X] I have already [searched in existing issues](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues?q=is%3Aissue+label%3ABug) and found no previous report of this bug.

### Describe the bug and add screenshots

Quite a slow query is in `classes/Hook.php:1202` 

![Immagine 2022-08-15 154249](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/184646838-18b7779b-063b-4620-b6e3-3dd7b2f1a5ef.png)

In the following query, `ps_module_shop` is joined twice, but only one join is needed.
``` 
SELECT SQL_NO_CACHE h.`name` as hook, m.`id_module`, h.`id_hook`, m.`name` as module
FROM `ps_module` m
INNER JOIN ps_module_shop module_shop
ON (module_shop.id_module = m.id_module AND module_shop.id_shop = 2 AND module_shop.enable_device & 1)
INNER JOIN `ps_module_shop` `ms` ON ms.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
INNER JOIN `ps_hook_module` `hm` ON hm.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
INNER JOIN `ps_hook` `h` ON hm.`id_hook` = h.`id_hook`
LEFT JOIN `ps_module_group` `mg` ON mg.`id_module` = m.`id_module`
WHERE (h.`name` != "paymentOptions") AND (hm.`id_shop` = 2) AND (mg.id_shop = 2 AND  mg.`id_group` IN (3))
GROUP BY hm.id_hook, hm.id_module
ORDER BY hm.`position`
```



### Expected behavior

I expect queries to be optimized. 

Removing the extraneous join, the query is faster (half the time, only 2 ms, that is not much, but it is a tiny improvement).
![Immagine 2022-08-15 155107](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/7520695/184648092-8cd9baef-01b5-4c8b-97e0-51df70910c57.png)



### Steps to reproduce

1. Enable Debug profiler
2. Look for the query above on any page of the FO
3. Notice, that the table `ps_module_shop` is joined twice, and
    a. the extraneous (second) join is less restrictive than the first, but rows joined by the second query are a strict superset of those joined by the first query
    b. the alias `ms` is never used, neither in selected field, nor in conditions, nor elsewhere

### PrestaShop version(s) where the bug happened

1.7.8.7

### PHP version(s) where the bug happened

7.3
